items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: They booked me at the Philharmonic, but Calvin Jackson took my place; I was sick or something.

ctx.x: Yeah, he was doing sessions at Billy Berg's. The intermission piano player was Andre Previn. And (?) played was Coleman Hawkins, Sir Charles on piano, Denzil Best... And I did not show up... They booked me at the Philharmonic, but Calvin Jackson took my place; I was sick or something. So T-Bone Walker and I knew each other from back in Los Angeles.

It was all right. The only difficulty we had was you couldn't find a Hammond organ everywhere at that time. I went to Europe, and it was very...you know, it was scarce as far as organs were concerned.
